findings.limit: Context configuration is not a proof of actual colour transfer or brightness causality.

findings.finding: Defaults revision1/HDRtrue/AEtrue; compare-and-set rejects mismatched revision, unchanged flags do not increment revision, changes increment with max-to1 wrap. Context matching requires validity plus matching flag bits. Context reuse permits an already dispatched frame; replacement ignores invalid contexts, defers a mismatching valid context dispatched this nonzero current frame, otherwise reports ready.
findings.limit: Static policy, not a live transition assay.

findings.finding: ApplySet holds one mutex, clears dispatch evidence and stores new state only for a changed revision-matched request, then builds its status receipt inside that lock.
findings.limit: Static set contract; no mutation was executed by importer.
